data.body: [P2] Add composed coverage for grouped dispatch. The new dispatcher tests only call `unwrapEvent`; none exercises this handler or the envelope produced by `GroupedCloudDurableTestRunner`. Local example tests also bypass both components, so broken routing or forwarding can pass all local checks and fail only after deployment. CONTRIBUTING requires composed tests for changes spanning components. Add coverage passing the grouped runner's envelope through the dispatcher into a durable handler, checking example selection, original input, and suspension/replay behavior.
